notes: Tehlikeli comes from tehlike (danger) plus the suffix -li (having), meaning "having danger" or "full of danger".
Do not confuse it with riskli (risky), which often implies a chance of failure or financial loss, whereas tehlikeli suggests actual physical harm or threat.
